detail:
Full summary: Cut v2.0.0 stable: verified the three stable gates, exercised the reverse-migrate gate on a copy of this repo's live sqlite state (round-trip clean, counts identical), bumped 2.0.0, wrote the stable + missing beta.3 changelog sections. Tag v2.0.0 routes to dist-tag latest via CI.
Decisions: Exercised the reverse-migrate stable gate on a scratchpad copy of this repo's live sqlite state instead of the live store or an external project — migrate docs require stopping running sessions first, this session's stdio server would permanently disconnect if stopped, and no external project ever engaged. Round-trip sqlite→files→sqlite verified: 354 posts / 254 decisions / 484 entities / 1039 relations / 2 handoffs identical at every step, version stamped 2 on re-forward, first-wins config backup preserved byte-identical.; Judged the external-tester gate satisfied only weakly and proceeded anyway on Dave's explicit direction ('soak complete, no errors surfaced, continue with plan') — the salesforce project was enrolled (beta.1+beta.2 emails sent, no reply = no data-loss report) but no sent mail to Lanny.Ripple@gmail.com exists, so that enrollment likely remained an unsent draft. Dave is the authority on field reports; the git-push ask-rule prompt is his final go/no-go checkpoint.; Chose a rollup [2.0.0] changelog section leading with the Node floor and migrate contract, plus a backfilled [2.0.0-beta.3] section (which had never been written), over rewriting the beta sections into one — the betas are already tagged and GH-released history.; Left this repo's .mcp.json twining-mcp@next pin and the plugin server pin untouched at stable cut — dist-tag next (beta.3) is code-identical to 2.0.0, and the plugin pin bump is gated to one release after stable plus a quiet week.
Findings: v2.0.0-beta.3 shipped with no CHANGELOG section — the dashboard scale redesign was undocumented until the stable cut backfilled it. Release checklist should include a changelog check before tagging.; migrate --reverse prints 'previous config backed up to config.yml.pre-migrate.bak' even when the first-wins rule correctly skips the write because the backup already exists — cosmetic misreport, same class as issue #39 preview counts. Worth folding into #39 or a small v2.1 issue.; warning: external beta enrollment to Lanny.Ripple@gmail.com appears never sent — Gmail shows no sent mail to that address (connector is drafts-only; the draft was likely never dispatched). The ≥2-external-projects gate was effectively met by one project (salesforce) with silence-as-no-reports.; The 2026-07-09 CI failure on main (plugin-token-budget, 2c1a025) was fixed the same day by the token-budget rescope commit; last three main CI runs green. Full local test suite before the stable bump: 97 files, 1173 passed, 2 skipped.
